description: The alignment benchmark (design section 11.2): twelve paragraphs of cues in spoken form, with common words, number words, invented names, short and long cues, and cue boundaries with a pause (after a sentence) and without one (a cue that ends mid-sentence). Each boundary is marked with the pause expected, so the measured error can be split by boundary kind.
freeze: Draft. Frozen as version 1 only after gate H1 (plan.md section 5), when the owner has listened to sample renders. Until then the texts may change, and their hashes with them.
